title: Replace logos in translated images
summary: Swap a detected logo in the Image Translator for one from your library, an upload or Drive, then move and resize it by hand.

sections.title: Logo replacement in the Image Translator
sections.note: Swap a detected logo for one of your own.

items.body: Pick one from your logo library, upload it or browse Drive
Preview the fit, with a warning for low-resolution or odd-shaped logos
Drag or resize it by hand, and **Reset** to start over
